title: Compose Multiplatform with Spring service
description: Share client UI with Compose Multiplatform and add an independently configured Spring Boot server.

modules.responsibility: Android application entry, Activity, manifest, variants, and signing; depends on composeApp.
Xcode project and minimal Swift bootstrap into Kotlin; product UI and lifecycle behavior stay in composeApp.
Shared Compose root, client composition, and iOS framework target.
Shared client contracts and network, storage, and platform adapters.
Client feature contracts and behavior organized by capability.
Server entry point, Spring configuration, and deployment assembly.
Server use cases, HTTP adapters, persistence, and migrations.
